title: Whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out
arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
latin: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhrajan wa yarzuqhu min haytsu la yahtasib
translation: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect.
lesson: Taqwa opens doors you didn't know existed. Rizq is not just money - it's solutions, peace, people.
